verses.en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.pt: Escutai o meu ensino, povo meu; inclinai os vossos ouvidos às palavras da minha boca.
verses.en_web: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: <Maschil. Of Asaph.> Give ear, O my people, to my law; let your ears be bent down to the words of my mouth.

verses.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.pt: Abrirei a minha boca numa parábola; proporei enigmas da antigüidade,
verses.en_web: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
verses.en_bbe: Opening my mouth I will give out a story, even the dark sayings of old times;

verses.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.pt: coisas que temos ouvido e sabido, e que nossos pais nos têm contado.
verses.en_web: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.en_bbe: Which have come to our hearing and our knowledge, as they were given to us by our fathers.

verses.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.pt: Não os encobriremos aos seus filhos, cantaremos às gerações vindouras os louvores do Senhor, assim como a sua força e as maravilhas que tem feito.
verses.en_web: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
verses.en_bbe: We will not keep them secret from our children; we will make clear to the coming generation the praises of the Lord and his strength, and the great works of wonder which he has done.

verses.en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.pt: Porque ele estabeleceu um testemunho em Jacó, e instituiu uma lei em Israel, as quais coisas ordenou aos nossos pais que as ensinassem a seus filhos;
verses.en_web: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
verses.en_bbe: He put up a witness in Jacob, and made a law in Israel; which he gave to our fathers so that they might give knowledge of them to their children;

verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.pt: para que as soubesse a geração vindoura, os filhos que houvesse de nascer, os quais se levantassem e as contassem a seus filhos,
verses.en_web: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
verses.en_bbe: So that the generation to come might have knowledge of them, even the children of the future, who would give word of them to their children;

verses.en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.pt: a fim de que pusessem em Deus a sua esperança, e não se esquecessem das obras de Deus, mas guardassem os seus mandamentos;
verses.en_web: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
verses.en_bbe: So that they might put their hope in God, and not let God's works go out of their minds, but keep his laws;

verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.pt: e que não fossem como seus pais, geração contumaz e rebelde, geração de coração instável, cujo espírito não foi fiel para com Deus.
verses.en_web: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
verses.en_bbe: And not be like their fathers, a stiff-necked and uncontrolled generation; a generation whose heart was hard, whose spirit was not true to God.

verses.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Efraim, armados de arcos, retrocederam no dia da peleja.
verses.en_web: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.en_bbe: The children of Ephraim, armed with bows, were turned back on the day of the fight.

verses.en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.pt: Não guardaram o pacto de Deus, e recusaram andar na sua lei;
verses.en_web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
verses.en_bbe: They were not ruled by God's word, and they would not go in the way of his law;

verses.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.pt: esqueceram-se das suas obras e das maravilhas que lhes fizera ver.
verses.en_web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
verses.en_bbe: They let his works go out of their memory, and the wonders which he had made them see.

verses.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.pt: Maravilhas fez ele à vista de seus pais na terra do Egito, no campo de Zoá.
verses.en_web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.en_bbe: He did great works before the eyes of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.

verses.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.pt: Dividiu o mar, e os fez passar por ele; fez com que as águas parassem como um montão.
verses.en_web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
verses.en_bbe: The sea was cut in two so that they might go through; the waters were massed together on this side and on that.

verses.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.pt: Também os guiou de dia por uma nuvem, e a noite toda por um clarão de fogo.
verses.en_web: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
verses.en_bbe: In the daytime he was guiding them in the cloud, and all through the night with a light of fire.

verses.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.pt: Fendeu rochas no deserto, e deu-lhes de beber abundantemente como de grandes abismos.
verses.en_web: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
verses.en_bbe: The rocks of the waste land were broken by his power, and he gave them drink as out of the deep waters.

verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.pt: Da penha fez sair fontes, e fez correr águas como rios.
verses.en_web: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.en_bbe: He made streams come out of the rock; and waters came flowing down like rivers.

verses.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.pt: Todavia ainda prosseguiram em pecar contra ele, rebelando-se contra o Altíssimo no deserto.
verses.en_web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on sinning against him even more, turning away from the Most High in the waste land;

verses.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.pt: E tentaram a Deus nos seus corações, pedindo comida segundo o seu apetite.
verses.en_web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
verses.en_bbe: Testing God in their hearts, requesting meat for their desire.

verses.en: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.pt: Também falaram contra Deus, dizendo: Poderá Deus porventura preparar uma mesa no deserto? Acaso fornecerá carne para o seu povo?
verses.en_web: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.en_bbe: They said bitter words against God, saying, Is God able to make ready a table in the waste land?

verses.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor, quando os ouviu, se indignou; e acendeu um fogo contra Jacó, e a sua ira subiu contra Israel;
verses.en_web: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
verses.en_bbe: See, the rock was cut open by his power, so that the water came rushing out, and overflowing streams; is he able to give us bread? is he able to get meat for his people?

verses.en: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor, quando os ouviu, se indignou; e acendeu um fogo contra Jacó, e a sua ira subiu contra Israel;
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
verses.en_bbe: So these things came to the Lord's ears, and he was angry; and a fire was lighted against Jacob, and wrath came up against Israel;

verses.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.pt: porque não creram em Deus nem confiaram na sua salvação.
verses.en_web: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
verses.en_bbe: Because they had no faith in God, and no hope in his salvation.

verses.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.pt: Contudo ele ordenou às nuvens lá em cima, e abriu as portas dos céus;
verses.en_web: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to the clouds on high, and the doors of heaven were open;

verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.pt: fez chover sobre eles maná para comerem, e deu-lhes do trigo dos céus.
verses.en_web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent down manna like rain for their food, and gave them the grain of heaven.

verses.en: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.pt: Cada um comeu o pão dos poderosos; ele lhes mandou comida em abundância.
verses.en_web: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
verses.en_bbe: Man took part in the food of strong ones; he sent them meat in full measure.

verses.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.pt: Fez soprar nos céus o vento do oriente, e pelo seu poder trouxe o vento sul.
verses.en_web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
verses.en_bbe: He sent an east wind from heaven, driving on the south wind by his power.

verses.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.pt: Sobre eles fez também chover carne como poeira, e aves de asas como a areia do mar;
verses.en_web: He rained also meat on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.
verses.en_bbe: He sent down meat on them like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the sea,

verses.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.pt: e as fez cair no meio do arraial deles, ao redor de suas habitações.
verses.en_web: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
verses.en_bbe: And he let it come down into their resting-place, round about their tents.

verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.pt: Então comeram e se fartaram bem, pois ele lhes trouxe o que cobiçavam.
verses.en_web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
verses.en_bbe: So they had food and were full; for he gave them their desire;

verses.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.pt: Não refrearam a sua cobiça. Ainda lhes estava a comida na boca,
verses.en_web: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
verses.en_bbe: But they were not turned from their desires; and while the food was still in their mouths,

verses.en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
verses.pt: quando a ira de Deus se levantou contra eles, e matou os mais fortes deles, e prostrou os escolhidos de Israel.
verses.en_web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: The wrath of God came on them, and put to death the fattest of them, and put an end to the young men of Israel.

verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.pt: Com tudo isso ainda pecaram, e não creram nas suas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
verses.en_bbe: For all this they went on sinning even more, and had no faith in his great wonders.

verses.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.pt: Pelo que consumiu os seus dias como um sopo, e os seus anos em repentino terror.
verses.en_web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
verses.en_bbe: So their days were wasted like a breath, and their years in trouble.

verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.pt: Quando ele os fazia morrer, então o procuravam; arrependiam-se, e de madrugada buscavam a Deus.
verses.en_web: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
verses.en_bbe: When he sent death on them, then they made search for him; turning to him and looking for him with care;

verses.en: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.pt: Lembravam-se de que Deus era a sua rocha, e o Deus Altíssimo o seu Redentor.
verses.en_web: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
verses.en_bbe: In the memory that God was their Rock, and the Most High God their saviour.

verses.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.pt: Todavia lisonjeavam-no com a boca, e com a língua lhe mentiam.
verses.en_web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
verses.en_bbe: But their lips were false to him, and their tongues were untrue to him;

verses.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.pt: Pois o coração deles não era constante para com ele, nem foram eles fiéis ao seu pacto.
verses.en_web: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
verses.en_bbe: And their hearts were not right with him, and they did not keep their agreement with him.

verses.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.pt: Mas ele, sendo compassivo, perdoou a sua iniqüidade, e não os destruiu; antes muitas vezes desviou deles a sua cólera, e não acendeu todo o seu furor.
verses.en_web: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
verses.en_bbe: But he, being full of pity, has forgiveness for sin, and does not put an end to man: frequently turning back his wrath, and not being violently angry.

verses.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.pt: Porque se lembrou de que eram carne, um vento que passa e não volta.
verses.en_web: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
verses.en_bbe: So he kept in mind that they were only flesh; a breath which is quickly gone, and will not come again.

verses.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.pt: Quantas vezes se rebelaram contra ele no deserto, e o ofenderam no ermo!
verses.en_web: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
verses.en_bbe: How frequently did they go against him in the waste land, and give him cause for grief in the dry places!

verses.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.pt: Voltaram atrás, e tentaram a Deus; e provocaram o Santo de Israel.
verses.en_web: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Again they put God to the test, and gave pain to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.pt: Não se lembraram do seu poder, nem do dia em que os remiu do adversário,
verses.en_web: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
verses.en_bbe: They did not keep in mind the work of his hand, or the day when he took them from the power of their haters;

verses.en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.pt: nem de como operou os seus sinais no Egito, e as suas maravilhas no campo de Zoã,
verses.en_web: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
verses.en_bbe: How he had done his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan;

verses.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.pt: convertendo em sangue os seus rios, para que não pudessem beber das suas correntes.
verses.en_web: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
verses.en_bbe: So that their rivers were turned to blood, and they were not able to get drink from their streams.

verses.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.pt: Também lhes mandou enxames de moscas que os consumiram, e rãs que os destruíram.
verses.en_web: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.en_bbe: He sent different sorts of flies among them, poisoning their flesh; and frogs for their destruction.

verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.pt: Entregou às lagartas as novidades deles, e o fruto do seu trabalho aos gafanhotos.
verses.en_web: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
verses.en_bbe: He gave the increase of their fields to worms, the fruits of their industry to the locusts.

verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.pt: Destruiu as suas vinhas com saraiva, e os seus sicômoros com chuva de pedra.
verses.en_web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
verses.en_bbe: He sent ice for the destruction of their vines; their trees were damaged by the bitter cold.

verses.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.pt: Também entregou à saraiva o gado deles, e aos coriscos os seus rebanhos.
verses.en_web: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.en_bbe: Ice was rained down on their cattle; thunderstorms sent destruction among the flocks.

verses.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.pt: E atirou sobre eles o ardor da sua ira, o furor, a indignação, e a angústia, qual companhia de anjos destruidores.
verses.en_web: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
verses.en_bbe: He sent on them the heat of his wrath, his bitter disgust, letting loose evil angels among them.

verses.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.pt: Deu livre curso à sua ira; não os poupou da morte, mas entregou a vida deles à pestilência.
verses.en_web: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
verses.en_bbe: He let his wrath have its way; he did not keep back their soul from death, but gave their life to disease.

verses.en: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.pt: Feriu todo primogênito no Egito, primícias da força deles nas tendas de Cão.
verses.en_web: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
verses.en_bbe: He gave to destruction all the first sons of Egypt; the first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;

verses.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.pt: Mas fez sair o seu povo como ovelhas, e os guiou pelo deserto como a um rebanho.
verses.en_web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.en_bbe: But he took his people out like sheep, guiding them in the waste land like a flock.

verses.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.pt: Guiou-os com segurança, de sorte que eles não temeram; mas aos seus inimigos, o mar os submergiu.
verses.en_web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.en_bbe: He took them on safely so that they had no fear; but their haters were covered by the sea.

verses.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.pt: Sim, conduziu-os até a sua fronteira santa, até o monte que a sua destra adquirira.
verses.en_web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
verses.en_bbe: And he was their guide to his holy land, even to the mountain, which his right hand had made his;

verses.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.pt: Expulsou as nações de diante deles; e dividindo suas terras por herança, fez habitar em suas tendas as tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.en_bbe: Driving out nations before them, marking out the line of their heritage, and giving the people of Israel their tents for a resting-place.

verses.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.pt: Contudo tentaram e provocaram o Deus Altíssimo, e não guardaram os seus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies;
verses.en_bbe: But they were bitter against the Most High God, testing him, and not keeping his laws;

verses.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.pt: Mas tornaram atrás, e portaram-se aleivosamente como seus pais; desviaram-se como um arco traiçoeiro.
verses.en_web: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
verses.en_bbe: Their hearts were turned back and untrue like their fathers; they were turned to one side like a twisted bow.

verses.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.pt: Pois o provocaram à ira com os seus altos, e o incitaram a zelos com as suas imagens esculpidas.
verses.en_web: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
verses.en_bbe: They made him angry with their high places; moving him to wrath with their images.

verses.en: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.pt: Ao ouvir isso, Deus se indignou, e sobremodo abominou a Israel.
verses.en_web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;
verses.en_bbe: When this came to God's ears he was very angry, and gave up Israel completely;

verses.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.pt: Pelo que desamparou o tabernáculo em Siló, a tenda da sua morada entre os homens,
verses.en_web: So that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.en_bbe: So that he went away from the holy place in Shiloh, the tent which he had put among men;

verses.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.
verses.pt: dando a sua força ao cativeiro, e a sua glória à mão do inimigo.
verses.en_web: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
verses.en_bbe: And he let his strength be taken prisoner, and gave his glory into the hands of his hater.

verses.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.pt: Entregou o seu povo à espada, e encolerizou-se contra a sua herança.
verses.en_web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: He gave his people up to the sword, and was angry with his heritage.

verses.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.pt: Aos seus mancebos o fogo devorou, e suas donzelas não tiveram cântico nupcial.
verses.en_web: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
verses.en_bbe: Their young men were burned in the fire; and their virgins were not praised in the bride-song.

verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.pt: Os seus sacerdotes caíram à espada, e suas viúvas não fizeram pranto.
verses.en_web: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
verses.en_bbe: Their priests were put to death by the sword, and their widows made no weeping for them.

verses.en: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.pt: Então o Senhor despertou como dum sono, como um valente que o vinho excitasse.
verses.en_web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
verses.en_bbe: Then was the Lord like one awaking from sleep, and like a strong man crying out because of wine.

verses.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.pt: E fez recuar a golpes os seus adversários; infligiu-lhes eterna ignomínia.
verses.en_web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.en_bbe: His haters were turned back by his blows and shamed for ever.

verses.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.pt: Além disso, rejeitou a tenda de José, e não escolheu a tribo de Efraim;
verses.en_web: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.en_bbe: And he put the tent of Joseph on one side, and took not the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.pt: antes escolheu a tribo de Judá, o monte Sião, que ele amava.
verses.en_web: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
verses.en_bbe: But he took the tribe of Judah for himself, and the mountain of Zion, in which he had pleasure.

verses.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.pt: Edificou o seu santuário como os lugares elevados, como a terra que fundou para sempre.
verses.en_web: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
verses.en_bbe: And he made his holy place like the high heaven, like the earth which is fixed by him for ever.

verses.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.pt: Também escolheu a Davi, seu servo, e o tirou dos apriscos das ovelhas;
verses.en_web: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.en_bbe: He took David to be his servant, taking him from the place of the flocks;

verses.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.pt: de após as ovelhas e suas crias o trouxe, para apascentar a Jacó, seu povo, e a Israel, sua herança.
verses.en_web: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: From looking after the sheep which were giving milk, he took him to give food to Jacob his people, and to Israel his heritage.

verses.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.pt: E ele os apascentou, segundo a integridade do seu coração, e os guiou com a perícia de suas mãos.
verses.en_web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
verses.en_bbe: So he gave them food with an upright heart, guiding them by the wisdom of his hands.
